purpose: Specify the exact fresh public observation required before a metadata-only edit of an existing Zenodo record can be frozen.

target.title_must_remain: Von Softwarearchitektur zur Weltformel – DAS UNIVERSUM ALS ROUND TRIP

acceptance_rules: record id, concept record id, DOI and concept DOI MUST equal target
revision MUST be a positive integer
the raw response and extracted metadata MUST be canonicalizable UTF-8 JSON objects
the extracted metadata MUST satisfy the published-metadata editor's exact allowlist

historical_context_not_usable_for_execut.reason: A later public change could invalidate every bound identity. This retained observation is only historical context.
